crossRefs.note: Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week. He gave him Rachel his daughter as wife.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Rachel
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of Joseph and Benjamin

translations.web: Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week. He gave him Rachel his daughter as wife.
translations.bsb: And Jacob did just that. He finished the week’s celebration, and Laban gave him his daughter Rachel as his wife.
translations.kjv: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week: and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife
translations.asv: And jacob did so, and fulfilled her week. And he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife.
